caption: The drawing depicts a single carved wooden bird figure, positioned upright and facing to the left. The bird has a green head and neck, with a large, dark, round eye and a brown beak. Its body is primarily brown with carved details to suggest wings and feathers, and its legs are yellowish, ending in green feet that are part of a pedestal-like base. The colors are earthy and muted, with shading that defines the textures and contours of the carving. The background is a plain, light beige with no other objects present. There is small text below the figure that reads "William H. Edwards. Del. 550."
title: Pa. German Carved Bird
